scope: All located Vishesh experiment families and distinct attempts, including model, scripted, setup-failed and unrun designs. Antsy v1–v3 are aliases for adaptive-quorum, adaptive-quorum-v2 and repair-v3; they are not extra OCR experiments.

count_definitions.planned: assigned or planned scientific opportunities at the stated unit; unrun plans explicitly marked
count_definitions.started: scientific opportunities whose execution began; qualification calls are separate from downstream worlds
count_definitions.terminal: started opportunities with a terminal endpoint or recorded terminal failure; excludes unstarted/not-run assignments
count_definitions.completed: opportunities attaining the planned protocol endpoint; correctness and scientific benefit are separate
count_definitions.valid: schema/contract-valid endpoint; a valid answer can be wrong
count_definitions.incomplete: started opportunities without a terminal disposition; does not count unstarted plans
count_definitions.errored: opportunities with reported execution/contract errors; may overlap terminal and incomplete
count_definitions.missing: assigned opportunities with no usable observed endpoint or terminal failure, normally unstarted plus unresolved partial opportunities; not a refusal count
count_definitions.refused: explicit provider/model refusal to perform the task; valid WAIT/STOP/DEFER/UNCERTAIN actions excluded; null where incomplete response coverage prevents classification
count_definitions.unstarted: extra per-attempt field: planned minus started when both are known
count_definitions.unknown: JSON null, never assumed zero; counts cannot be summed across mixed units or recovered prefixes

important_findings: Immune A2 directly exhibits persistent inaction: seven of nine incident arms WAIT all six ticks despite failing visible telemetry. This is completed inference with false evidence claims, not an observed refusal.
Baseline competence and schema-contract failures recur. Hub completion or clean preservation alone does not establish scientific qualification.
Large reported denominators often count dependent policy rows, deterministic replays or logical uses of cached calls.
Healing strong central verified controls beat peer architectures; Antsy committees underperform confidence-only and never stop early.
Theseus v1 gives positive supplied-information transmission on six paired worlds. Both later v2 qualification cohorts fail at least one clean competence gate in hub metrics.
No explicit refusal was identified in the saved parsed traces inspected. Missing responses, generic PolicyErrors and families without actual journals prevent a zero-refusal claim for the program.
